verdict.rationale: jo's own docs say you can give it a job and a schedule and get recurring outputs (weekly plan, morning priorities, weekend task review) without asking each time. Its always-on cloud machine lets it work overnight and prepare results before you wake, which it delivers through the macOS app, Telegram, WhatsApp, or email. missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-off (single future-time) scheduled tasks as distinct from recurring schedules, detailed docs on how schedules are configured and managed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: Give jo a job and a schedule. Get a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time.
because jo has its own machine, it can work overnight: read what came in, watch what changed, and prepare your morning before you wake.
jo speaks on macOS (native app), Telegram, WhatsApp, and email — same memory and context across all of them.
